product: Royalty and product revenue. DARZALEX daratumumab from J&J had H1 2026 net sales $8,171M, plus Kesimpta royalties from Novartis, and EPKINLY/TEPKINLY epcoritamab global net sales $312M (plus 48%), per 2026-08-06 (ir.genmab.com). Epcoritamab, a subcutaneous CD3xCD20 bispecific, is the growth product.
demand: Volume-led, not price. H1 2026 revenue rose 25% to $2,051M on higher DARZALEX royalties (J&J net sales up 21% to $8,171M) and Kesimpta royalties, plus EPKINLY net sales up 48% to $312M, 2026-08-06 (ir.genmab.com). Royalty revenue $1,708M, up 24%. No dated evidence of net price increases.
pricing_power: Cost of product sales rose 51% to $149M on AbbVie EPKINLY profit-share, and adjusted operating expenses rose 28% versus 25% revenue growth, H1 2026, 2026-08-06 (ir.genmab.com). Heavy dependence on DARZALEX royalties; daratumumab biosimilars such as Celltrion CT-P44, with U.S. substance patent expiry 2029 and Europe 2031, 2024-11-28 (trial.medpath.com), would compress royalty margin.
competition: Closest low-cost threat is daratumumab biosimilars: Celltrion CT-P44 and Henlius HLX15, with U.S. patent expiry 2029 and Europe 2031, per 2024-11-28 (trial.medpath.com) and 2026-06-24 (pharmadossier.com). In China epcoritamab is itself approved by the NMPA on 2026-05-15, per 2026-05-19 (dengyuemed.com). No dated Chinese epcoritamab substitute found.
market_strategy: CEO Jan van de Winkel, 2026-06-29 (ir.genmab.com): we are building on our vision for epcoritamab as a core therapy across B-cell malignancies. On 2026-05-07 (ir.genmab.com): focus remained on disciplined execution, progressing these programs toward key readouts and preparing for potential launches. Company promised a 2026 wave of registrational readouts, 2026-03-18 (finance.yahoo.com).
bull: H1 2026 revenue +25% to $2,051M with guidance raised 2026-08-06; EPCORE DLBCL-4 cut progression risk 60% (HR 0.40) 2026-06-29; three Phase III readouts due Q4 2026.
bear: EPCORE DLBCL-1 missed overall survival 2026-07-23; opex +28% vs revenue +25%; DARZALEX royalty concentration with biosimilar expiry 2029; AbbVie trade-secret suit pending.
falsifier: Failure of any Q4 2026 Phase III readout (EPKINLY frontline DLBCL, Rina-S ovarian, petosemtamab head and neck), or the 2026-11-05 report showing royalties below the raised $3,625-3,750M range.
web_what_changed_30_90d: Last 30d: RSU and warrant grants to employees 2026-09-24 (ir.genmab.com); EGM convened for 2026-10-07 on board remuneration 2026-09-08; capital increase from warrant exercise 2026-09-08; shares hit 52-week high 35.48 USD 2026-09-23 (Investing.com). Last 90d: H1 2026 revenue +25% to $2,051M and guidance raised 2026-08-06 (ir.genmab.com); EPCORE DLBCL-4 positive PFS 2026-06-29; DLBCL-1 overall-survival miss clarified 2026-07-23 (news.abbvie.com).
web_true_now_not_modelled: Three pivotal Phase III readouts land in Q4 2026: EPKINLY plus R-CHOP in frontline DLBCL, Rina-S in second-line platinum-resistant ovarian cancer, and petosemtamab plus Keytruda in first-line head and neck cancer (2026-09-22 investing.com; 2026-09-27 Yahoo Finance). Royalty guidance was already raised on 2026-08-06. AbbVie trade-secret dismissal bid pending 2026-08-28 (legalnewsfeed.com).

DARZALEX daratumumab from J&J had H1 2026 net sales $8,171M, plus Kesimpta royalties from Novartis, and EPKINLY/TEPKINLY epcoritamab global net sales $312M (plus 48%), per 2026-08-06 (ir.genmab.com). Epcoritamab, a subcutaneous CD3xCD20 bispecific, is the growth product.
web_price_volume_mix: Volume-led, not price. H1 2026 revenue rose 25% to $2,051M on higher DARZALEX royalties (J&J net sales up 21% to $8,171M) and Kesimpta royalties, plus EPKINLY net sales up 48% to $312M, 2026-08-06 (ir.genmab.com). Royalty revenue $1,708M, up 24%. No dated evidence of net price increases.
web_bottleneck: The company's bottleneck is launch readiness and manufacturing scale for wholly-owned assets: H1 2026 adjusted operating expenses rose 28% to $1,270M on pipeline investment and global commercialization ahead of anticipated launches, 2026-08-06 (ir.genmab.com). Genmab relieves the patient-side access bottleneck of IV infusion or CAR-T logistics because epcoritamab is given subcutaneously, 2026-06-29 (ir.genmab.com).
web_who_benefits_next: AbbVie gains a profit-share on EPKINLY in the U.S. and Japan, J&J sells DARZALEX, and Novartis sells Kesimpta, all per 2026-08-06 (ir.genmab.com). Second-order: ADC and biologics contract manufacturers supplying Rina-S and petosemtamab. Third-order: Merus holders, paid $97.00 per share in the 2025-09-29 acquisition (ir.genmab.com).
web_who_loses: Chemoimmunotherapy and CAR-T franchises in relapsed or refractory DLBCL. EPCORE DLBCL-4 showed fixed-duration epcoritamab plus lenalidomide cut progression or death risk 60% versus R-GemOx, hazard ratio 0.40, 2026-06-29 (ir.genmab.com). Also the partner relationship: AbbVie is suing Genmab over ADC trade secrets, 2025-03-24 (fiercebiotech.com).

In China epcoritamab is itself approved by the NMPA on 2026-05-15, per 2026-05-19 (dengyuemed.com). No dated Chinese epcoritamab substitute found.
web_ceo_promised: CEO Jan van de Winkel, 2026-06-29 (ir.genmab.com): we are building on our vision for epcoritamab as a core therapy across B-cell malignancies. On 2026-05-07 (ir.genmab.com): focus remained on disciplined execution, progressing these programs toward key readouts and preparing for potential launches. Company promised a 2026 wave of registrational readouts, 2026-03-18 (finance.yahoo.com).
web_did_they_deliver: Partly. 2026 guidance was maintained 2026-05-07 then raised 2026-08-06, revenue midpoint $4,230M to $4,425M and adjusted operating profit $1,150M to $1,225M (ir.genmab.com). EPCORE DLBCL-4 met its primary PFS endpoint 2026-06-29 (ir.genmab.com). But EPCORE DLBCL-1 missed its sole U.S. primary endpoint, overall survival, 2026-07-23 (news.abbvie.com). Merus closed December 2025.
web_what_would_falsify: A failure on any of the three Q4 2026 Phase III readouts: EPKINLY frontline DLBCL interim, Rina-S platinum-resistant ovarian, petosemtamab first-line head and neck, per 2026-09-22 (investing.com). Or the 2026-11-05 next report (ir.genmab.com/financial-calendar) showing royalties below the raised $3,625-3,750M full-year range, 2026-08-06 (ir.genmab.com).
